title: Improvement of works in connection with Promotion of Tourism at Puducherry Lighthouse and DGNSS Station
summary: Online two-cover e-tender for civil and electrical improvement works to promote tourism at Puducherry Lighthouse and DGNSS Station, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Puducherry Lighthouse and DGNSS Station
sites.work: Civil and electrical improvement works for promotion of tourism

scope.item: Improvement of works in connection with Promotion of Tourism - Civil (Rs.49,51,229/-)
Improvement of works in connection with Promotion of Tourism - Electrical (Rs.5,39,327/-)

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST: Civil Rs.49,51,229, Electrical Rs.5,39,327. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, valid three months from technical bid opening. Tender fee 'as per NIT' by DD but amount not printed.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous body

Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two works each >= 50%, or one work >= 80%; only completed works with completion certificate; value updated at 7% p.a. simple
Experience certificates issued by officers below Executive Engineer not considered
Similar works: repairs and civil maintenance of building or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution with qualification and experience
Undertaking that tender is unconditional (Annexure III); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); affidavit/self-attestation of not being blacklisted
List of relatives serving in MoPSW or DGLL; Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)
notes: Document is the NIT (Section I) only; no BOQ. Download/submission period 10/10/2025 10:00 to 28/10/2025 15:00. Listing title omits 'and DGNSS Station'.
